lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The prior small-device, AX5, dark-mode, and semantic-order gap is resolved by a complete automated journey and audit. A human VoiceOver traversal and assistive-technology participant evaluation are still absent.
findings.evidence: accessibility-runtime.json records one 70.560-second pass on iPhone SE at 375x667, AX5, and dark mode; ax5-session-scope-before-audit.png shows the full relationship context; XCTest asserted review, completion, and Session order and completed Dynamic Type, hit-region, and description audits with zero unfiltered issues.
findings.user_impact: The critical path now has credible release evidence for enlarged text and accessibility semantics, but rotor behavior, announcement pacing, gesture cost, and real-user comprehension remain unobserved.
findings.recommendation: Run a manual VoiceOver traversal on hardware with one target assistive-technology user or trained evaluator, preserving the exact announcement sequence and any navigation traps.
findings.verification: Source and uncertainty are announced before submit, exact contact fields before the Apple write gate, cancellation before retry, and selected relationship plus the full unsent objective before Send, with no duplicate focus or trap.

findings.observation: The AX5 cancellation path is truthful and recoverable, but Contacts save, denial, duplicate, background, termination, and reconciliation states remain outside the executable bundle.
findings.evidence: ax5-apple-contact-editor.png and ax5-contact-cancelled.png prove exact-field review followed by no-write cancellation; artifact-manifest.json explicitly lists the other Contacts and lifecycle rows as unavailable.
findings.user_impact: A polished accessible cancel path does not yet prove truthful behavior when iOS permissions or process lifecycle change around the external write boundary.
findings.recommendation: Run the applicable Contacts and interruption rows from the mobile test matrix on a small and large supported iPhone without reading unrelated address-book data.
findings.verification: Every row yields one truthful state, no duplicate contact, no false success, no lost reviewed relationship, and one editable unsent Session draft.

findings.criterion: Evidence comparison under realistic OCR error
findings.observation: The source remains zoomable and precedes editable evidence at AX5, but this run does not seed a plausible wrong name or date and therefore does not prove correction under enlarged text.
findings.evidence: ax5-source-inspection.png and accessibility-runtime.json prove the source open, zoom, close, and return order; artifact-manifest.json lists seeded OCR correction as unavailable.
findings.user_impact: A subtle OCR mismatch may still survive if modal comparison becomes cognitively expensive at large text sizes.
findings.recommendation: Add a low-contrast synthetic fixture with one known OCR mismatch and preserve draft plus reading position while the recruiter compares and corrects it.
findings.verification: On small and large iPhones at AX5, the seeded mismatch is found and corrected, the original remains inspectable, and the persisted fragment contains reviewed rather than raw OCR text.

strengths: The complete changed path passes on the smallest supported iPhone at AX5 in dark mode rather than relying on static inspection.
The selected relationship is one accessible Button whose full Person and context value is preserved; its visual context wraps instead of truncating.
Evidence, uncertainty, action, result, scope, composer, and Send have explicit automated ordering assertions.
The Apple editor and double-confirmed cancellation remain usable at AX5, and the Session objective remains editable and unsent.
missing_evidence: Manual VoiceOver traversal and assistive-technology participant evidence.
Landscape, increased contrast, localization expansion, and hardware-device coverage.
Contacts save, denial, duplicate, interruption, and reconciliation states.
Seeded OCR mismatch correction at AX5.
open_questions: At AX5, should a prefilled Session collapse the starter prompts so the editable objective receives more visual space?
